implemented.gdn: Five NEON multi-token helpers now reuse private current-state blocks for decay and checked update. Removes declared 1/4/8 KiB duplicate array payload in single/four/eight-row helpers. Grouped state/output publication remains atomic; single-row finite-prefix and decayed-tail error behavior remains exact. Actual stack footprint/codegen is unmeasured.
implemented.suffix: One backward scan by historical match end preserves longest-match priority, recent-start ties and overlaps under the existing 64-token limit. Runtime reuses an eight-u32 stack proposal buffer per request; public Vec API remains fallible and independently owned. Target verification, transactions, output bounds, cancellation and default selection are unchanged.
implemented.nativeQ2: Optional object-safe direct initializer writes into a fresh bounded admitted resident extent. Prospective registry/handle publish only after initializer success, complete scale validation and deadline check. Existing submitters keep copied preparation with no duplicate scale scan. Source avoids nominally 2,888,663,040 bytes of startup host copying for default168 placement and avoids temporary packed-weight allocation; this is not measured traffic, peak RAM or startup latency. Primary/secondary arena bounds, signed DSP bytes, cleanup/session limits and conservative admission stay unchanged.
implemented.hostedGate: Fixed six-target hosted gate covers new portable suffix/runtime tests, Windows ARM64-only GDN/native arena tests, and portable prewarm mock tests. Source hashes now include both accelerator crates and the isolated NEON dependency. Native fake-arena tests never open a driver. Release analyzers and production linking include both accelerator libraries; owner-operated execution remains pending.
